AgentxBaseline.description: AgentX gate baseline: metric name -> value, for the point's concurrency.

_source.description: Where the numbers came from; documentation only, the gate ignores it.

AgentxBaseline.title: AgentxBaseline

AgentxLabels.description: What InferenceX files the AgentX result row under.

framework.description: Serving framework label; selects InferenceX's metrics parser.

model_prefix.description: InferenceX model prefix; also selects the trace corpus.

spec_decoding.description: Speculative decoding method recorded with the row, or none.

AgentxLabels.title: AgentxLabels

AgentxTask.description:
InferenceX AgentX trace replay at one concurrency.

Only what the tool provides is modeled; every other client setting,
including the context length, is pass-through env.

concurrency.description: Concurrent sessions; one value per server.

env.description: Client settings passed through untouched, e.g. AIPERF_MAX_CONTEXT_LENGTH.

fast.description: InferenceX's bring-up mode (AIPERF_EXPERIMENTAL_FAST): a fixed 20m window and one warmup per lane; duration must then be 20m. Its numbers are bring-up evidence, not a canonical result.

timeout.description: The task is killed and fails after this; longer than duration, to cover warmup and drain.

tolerance.description: Relative tolerance of the AgentX gate.

AgentxTask.title: AgentxTask

BaselineRef.description: Gate on another scenario's inline baseline for the same task.

from.description: Reference id of the scenario whose inline baseline for the same task (and, in a sweep, the same point) gates this one.

BaselineRef.title: BaselineRef

CustomTask.description: A command run against the servers, e.g. a correctness script.

command.description: Argv, run from the repo root.

env.description: Extra env. Values may use ${NAME} for names the tool provides (e.g. ${SCENARIO_RESULTS_DIR}); $$ is a literal $.

name.description: Unique name; selects the task in --only and names its log.

skip_rest_if_exit_ge.description: Skip the remaining tasks when this one exits with this code or higher.

timeout.description: The task is killed and fails after this.

CustomTask.title: CustomTask

name.description: --dataset-name. Others are added with a lane that uses them.

EvalBaseline.description: Eval gate baseline: lm_eval run key -> {"<metric>,<filter>": value}.

_source.description: Where the numbers came from; documentation only, the gate ignores it.

EvalBaseline.title: EvalBaseline

EvalTask.description: Accuracy evals, gated against a baseline.

baseline.description: Inline baseline by run key, or {from: <ref>}.

tolerance.description: Smallest score drop the eval gate allows, in absolute terms; the gate widens it by the measured stderr.

EvalTask.title: EvalTask

Kv.description: The KV transfer side of one engine in a disaggregated scenario.

connector.description: KV connector; the tool adds its module path and port wiring.

role.description: KV role of this engine: kv_producer, kv_consumer or kv_both.

Kv.title: Kv

LmEval.description: lm-eval against the endpoint's /v1/chat/completions, one run per task.

concurrency.description: Client-side sweep: every task runs once per value, with num_concurrent set to it, against one server.

gen_kwargs.description: --gen_kwargs: a string verbatim, or a mapping as JSON.

limit.description: Questions per task (per subtask); unset or all runs the full set.

model_args.description: --model_args entries; the tool adds model and base_url.

tasks.description: Task names, or mappings with per-task options.

LmEval.title: LmEval

LmEvalTask.description: One lm_eval task with options of its own.

env.description: Env of this task's lm_eval run, e.g. HF_ALLOW_CODE_EVAL.

include_path.description: --include_path, for tasks defined in this repo.

limit.description: Questions (per subtask); overrides lm_eval.limit; all runs the full set.

limit_per_concurrency.description: Raises the limit at each lm_eval.concurrency value to ceil(N x concurrency / subtasks), so that concurrency is reached.

subtasks.description: Subtasks lm_eval applies the limit to one by one, e.g. 14 for mmlu_pro; divides limit_per_concurrency.

LmEvalTask.title: LmEvalTask

ModelSpec.description: The model a server loads and the name clients call it by.

name.description: What clients call the model; always passed as --served-model-name.

path.description: What the server loads (--model): a Hugging Face id, a local path, or a gs:// or s3:// URI. Defaults to name.

ModelSpec.title: ModelSpec

PerConcurrency.description: A count that scales with each cell's concurrency.

per_concurrency.description: Multiplied by the cell's concurrency: N x concurrency.

PerConcurrency.title: PerConcurrency

PerfBaseline.description: Perf gate baseline: cell key -> gated values.

_source.description: Where the numbers came from; documentation only, the gate ignores it.

PerfBaseline.title: PerfBaseline

PerfCellBaseline.description: Gated values of one perf cell, in check_regression.py's terms.

completed.description: Requests completed; a run must complete at least 95% as many.

median_tpot_ms.description: Median time per output token, ms.

median_ttft_ms.description: Median time to first token, ms; gated only when present.

num_prompts.description: Prompts sent at calibration; not gated.

output_throughput.description: Older name of output_token_throughput, still read by the gate.

total_token_throughput.description: Input and output tokens per second.

PerfCellBaseline.title: PerfCellBaseline

PerfCellGroup.description: Explicit perf cells, as an alternative to the isl_osl x concurrency product.

label.description: Cell key and --label. May use {isl}, {osl}, {concurrency} and {repeat}; without it the key is isl{I}_osl{O}_c{C}.

num_prompts.description: Prompts per cell; defaults to the task's.

repeat.description: Runs of each cell; more than one needs {repeat} in label.

PerfCellGroup.title: PerfCellGroup

PerfTask.description: Fixed-length benchmark cells against the server or router.

baseline.description: Inline baseline keyed by cell, or {from: <ref>}.

cells.description: Explicit cells instead of isl_osl x concurrency.

client.description: vllm-bench runs vllm bench serve; inferencex runs InferenceX's benchmark_serving at the version baked into the image.

client_args.description: Extra client flags, rendered like server.args.

env.description: Env for the client process, passed through untouched.

isl_osl.description: [input length, output length] pairs; one cell per pair and concurrency.

num_prompts.description: Prompts per measured run: a number or {per_concurrency: N}.

num_warmups.description: Warmup requests before each measured run (--num-warmups): a number or {per_concurrency: N}.

random_range_ratio.description: Length jitter of the random dataset; required with it.

range_ratio_style.description: How random_range_ratio reads for vllm-bench: symmetric is vllm bench serve's own form; min is translated to it as run_benchmarks.sh does. Not used by inferencex.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature; unset sends none (server default).

tokenizer.description: Client tokenizer. Unset: the server's pulled weights for an object-storage model, else model.name.

tolerance.description: Relative tolerance of the perf gate.

warmup_runs.description: Whole warmup passes per cell, discarded, before the measured run.

PerfTask.title: PerfTask

PointBaselines.description: Baselines of one generated sweep point, by task.
PointBaselines.title: PointBaselines

Role.description: One engine of a multi-role scenario, e.g. prefill or decode.

args.description: vllm serve flags over server.args for this role; null removes an inherited flag.

env.description: Env over server.env for this role; null removes an inherited entry.

kv.description: KV transfer role of this engine.

slice.description: Slice this role runs on, e.g. tpu7x/2x2x1.

Role.title: Role

Router.description: The proxy in front of a multi-role scenario's engines.

args.description: Extra router flags, rendered like server.args.

command.description: Argv the wiring flags are appended to, e.g. [python3, examples/disagg/toy_proxy_server.py].

type.description: Selects the wiring flags the tool adds (hosts and ports of the producer and consumer roles).

Router.title: Router

Server.description: What runs: image, model, slice or roles, flags and env.

args.description: vllm serve flags for every role: true -> --k, false -> --no-k, a scalar -> --k v, a list or mapping -> --k <compact JSON>.

env.description: Env for every server process of every role.

image.description: ci for this build's CI image, otherwise a full image URI with a tag or digest.

multihost.description: How a multi-host slice runs one engine: vLLM's own multi-node DP (mp) or Ray. Required exactly when a slice has more than one host.

roles.description: Two or more roles, e.g. prefill and decode, in run order. Exactly one of slice and roles.

router.description: Proxy in front of the roles; only with roles.

scratch.description: Temporary space every server host needs, e.g. 64Gi; the target decides where it comes from.

slice.description: Slice of the single role. Exactly one of slice and roles.

startup_timeout.description: Engine startup budget: sets VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S, and the readiness wait is this plus a margin.

Server.title: Server

Sweep.description: Points that each run on a fresh server. Exactly one of points, zip, product.

baselines.description: Baselines of zip and product points, by point name and task. Named points carry their own.

name.description: Point name template for zip and product, e.g. c{tasks.agentx.concurrency}; each {path} is one of the axes.

product.description: Dotted path -> values; one point per combination, the first axis outermost.

zip.description: Dotted path -> values; equal lengths, point i takes value i of every axis.

Sweep.title: Sweep

SweepPoint.description: A named point: an overlay over the scenario for one server.

name.description: Unique; results and baselines use it.

server.description: Overlay on server, merged above the scenario for this point.

tasks.description: Overlay on tasks; also holds this point's baselines.

SweepPoint.title: SweepPoint

Tasks.description: What runs against the servers. Empty means serve only.

agentx.description: AgentX trace replay; must be the only task.

custom.description: Commands, run after perf and before eval.

driver.description: Where tasks and the router run: a role (its first host) or client (a chipless host). Required with server.roles.

Tasks.title: Tasks

description: One workload: the servers to start and the tasks to run against them.

extends.description: Parent scenario, merged under this file: mappings merge, lists and scalars replace, null deletes. Baselines are not inherited.

name.description: Unique across scenarios/; names the results directory. Not inherited through extends.

sweep.description: Server-side sweep: each point is a fresh server with its overrides.

title: scenario
